component.name: FSR 1 Upscale Filter
component.summary: Video filter that upscales sources with FSR 1, NIS, RAVU, SGSR or the FSRCNNX neural network

description.p: Adds an upscaling video filter to OBS Studio. It upscales a source, for example a webcam, a low-resolution capture card or a game, to a higher resolution. Five algorithms are available, all running as plain shaders on any GPU:

ul.li: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0 (edge-adaptive upsampling and sharpening)
Snapdragon Game Super Resolution 1, fast and suited for games
FSRCNNX, a small neural network from mpv for cameras and real-life content

description.p: New algorithms: Snapdragon Game Super Resolution 1 (SGSR) and the FSRCNNX neural network in two sizes (8 and 16 channels). README in English.
